📖 How to use

      
  1. Set the number of lines, line height and corner radius.
  2. Toggle the shimmer sweep effect and pick base/shimmer colors.
  3. Preview the skeleton block live.
  4. Click "Copy HTML + CSS" to grab the snippet.

    

    

      
❓ Frequently asked questions

      
Does the skeleton need JavaScript?
Yes — the snippet is plain CSS (plus a few empty divs). No JavaScript is needed.
How do I make it look like text lines?
Change the line count and line height; the generator also randomizes line widths so the preview looks like real text.
Can I make a static skeleton without shimmer?
Toggle shimmer off and both layers use the same base color for a calm static placeholder.
